justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/Doc.java` (772 LOC), `OpsBuilder.java` (658 LOC), `Input.java`, `InputOutput.java`, `Output.java`, `DocBuilder.java`, `Newlines.java`, `Indent.java`, `CommentsHelper.java`, `Op.java`, `OpenOp.java`, `CloseOp.java`, `FormatterDiagnostic.java`, and `FormattingError.java`. The package has 14 production classes totaling 2466 LOC, but they are split into a cohesive formatter pipeline (input, ops, doc tree, break decisions, and output) with no evidence of unrelated responsibilities or a single overcentralized component, so the package is not a God Component.
